captions.detailed: A compact laboratory monocular microscope featuring a heavy rectangular base with rounded corners, a vertical cylindrical column, and a separate stage support. The optical head assembly consists of a black main tube, an angled monocular eyepiece, a rotating objective turret at the bottom, and a rear mounting carriage. The specimen stage is a flat black rectangular platform complete with silver slide-holder clips and a glass-like slide, mounted on a support bracket with coaxial adjustment knobs at the front. The optical assembly slides vertically along the main column, the objective turret rotates about its optical axis, and the stage carriage adjusts horizontally with rotating side control knobs.
captions.instruction: Generate a laboratory monocular microscope as an articulated assembly using CadQuery. The model should include a heavy rounded rectangular base, a vertical support column, a separate stage support, a rectangular black specimen stage with slide clips, and an optical body with an angled eyepiece and rotating objective turret. Define prismatic joints for the vertical focus adjustment of the optical body and horizontal stage movement, as well as continuous rotational joints for the objective turret and the stage adjustment knobs.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope by defining parts for the base, the vertical column, the stage support, the stage carriage, and the optical body carriage. Use a rounded box for the base, cylinders for the vertical post, and extruded profiles or boxes for the stage bracket and stage platform. Model the optical body carriage using a combination of vertical and angled cylinders for the eyepiece and objective turret. Establish a prismatic joint along the Z-axis of the vertical column for the optical carriage, a continuous rotational joint for the objective turret, a prismatic joint along the X-axis for the stage carriage, and a continuous rotational joint for the coaxial adjustment knob.
